authorization.scope: public no-login sources approved by customer
sources: FABDEM/ALOS and other public terrain sources
excluded: credentials, tokens, cookies or private browser state

artifacts.limitation: Records missing data and acceptance criteria; does not contain customer rows or credentials.

artifacts.source: Climate Hazards Center CHIRPS v2.0 global daily 0.05 degree
artifacts.license_or_terms: CHIRPS public data terms; retain source attribution
artifacts.limitation: Daily and 0.05 degree product; not a local gauge/radar field and not event calibration evidence.

artifacts.source: Climate Hazards Center CHIRPS v2.0 global daily 0.05 degree
artifacts.license_or_terms: CHIRPS public data terms; retain source attribution
artifacts.limitation: Daily and 0.05 degree product; cannot represent urban convective rainfall structure.

artifacts.source: Climate Hazards Center CHIRPS v2.0 global daily 0.05 degree
artifacts.license_or_terms: CHIRPS public data terms; retain source attribution
artifacts.limitation: Daily and 0.05 degree product; not suitable for direct SWMM event calibration.

artifacts.source: HOT Export Tool, United Arab Emirates waterways
artifacts.license_or_terms: OpenStreetMap data, ODbL; attribution and share-alike obligations apply
artifacts.limitation: Not a surveyed stormwater network, invert inventory, capacity model or coastal boundary condition.

artifacts.source: CHIRPS v2.0 daily rasters listed above
artifacts.limitation: Daily values have no defensible sub-daily distribution and are not expanded into hourly forcing.

artifacts.source: OCHA/HDX United Arab Emirates subnational administrative boundaries
artifacts.license_or_terms: HDX dataset terms and source attribution
artifacts.limitation: Administrative polygons do not provide parcel, building, drainage or inundation observations.

artifacts.source: Element 84 Earth Search Sentinel-1 GRD STAC
artifacts.license_or_terms: Copernicus Sentinel data legal notice; Earth Search assets marked requester-pays/proprietary hosting
artifacts.limitation: STAC discovery succeeded, but tested AWS/Planetary Computer raster URLs returned access restrictions; no flood extent is claimed.

artifacts.source: Microsoft Planetary Computer Sentinel-1 GRD collection metadata
artifacts.limitation: Collection metadata is not an event image and does not prove inundation.

artifacts.source: NASA CMR GPM IMERG Final V07 half-hourly granule catalog
artifacts.license_or_terms: NASA GPM data terms; Earthdata Login required for tested data download
artifacts.limitation: CMR discovery is complete for the queried point/bbox, but no HDF5 was retained because the data endpoint redirected to Earthdata Login.

not_obtained_or_still_missing.data: NCM quality-controlled rain gauges and weather radar QPE for 2024-04-15..17
not_obtained_or_still_missing.reason: A customer-side station directory was identified, but observation time series and radar archives were not available within the approved public no-login boundary.
not_obtained_or_still_missing.requested_from: NCM or customer-authorized meteorological data owner
not_obtained_or_still_missing.required_for: event calibration, spatial rainfall field, blind validation

not_obtained_or_still_missing.data: Sentinel-1 event raster or Copernicus EMS/UNOSAT flood extent
not_obtained_or_still_missing.reason: Public catalogs were found, but tested raster assets require account/requester-pays access and no Abu Dhabi-specific EMS/UNOSAT layer was identified.
not_obtained_or_still_missing.requested_from: customer remote-sensing account or Copernicus EMS activation archive

not_obtained_or_still_missing.data: Hourly tide, storm surge and outfall boundary levels
not_obtained_or_still_missing.reason: IOC public station search returned no UAE/Abu Dhabi match in the queried station catalog; monthly climatology would not be adequate for this event.
not_obtained_or_still_missing.requested_from: DMT/coastal authority, port operator, IOC/PSMSL/GESLA station owner
not_obtained_or_still_missing.required_for: coastal boundary, backwater and non-free-outfall simulation

not_obtained_or_still_missing.data: Engineering DTM/LiDAR with vertical datum and breaklines
not_obtained_or_still_missing.reason: Existing Copernicus/SRTM and SmartMakani 2017 contour/bathymetry are diagnostic candidates, not an engineering micro-topography surface.
not_obtained_or_still_missing.required_for: credible 2D surface routing and depth calibration

not_obtained_or_still_missing.data: Pump/gate operations, inlet capacity, storage and maintenance logs
not_obtained_or_still_missing.reason: Makani asset geometry and candidate facilities are available, but event-time controls and hydraulic curves are absent.
not_obtained_or_still_missing.required_for: SWMM controls, non-zero SWMM-ANUGA exchange and operational counterfactuals

not_obtained_or_still_missing.data: Timed flood depth/extent/recession and road impact observations
not_obtained_or_still_missing.reason: No authoritative event observation set is present in the public sources tested.
not_obtained_or_still_missing.requested_from: DMT, municipality, emergency response and road operations
not_obtained_or_still_missing.required_for: calibration, validation, impact model and GWM training labels

current_model_gate.gwm_role: shadow state emulator, uncertainty-aware surrogate and scenario-ranking layer after traditional-model calibration
current_model_gate.prediction_claim: No city-scale operational prediction or event accuracy claim is enabled by this acquisition round.
